title: API Control Endpoints
description:
API Control Endpoints
- Extend src/api/server.ts to support POST methods + CORS preflight
- Add parseBody(req): Promise<unknown> helper — reads request body, JSON.parse
- Add CORS preflight: OPTIONS → 200 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin/Methods/Headers
- Change method check: remove "GET only" guard, route by method+url combination
- New GET endpoints:
  - GET /api/config → readFileSync .deckent/config.json, return JSON
  - GET /api/doctor → import runDoctorChecks from cli/commands/doctor.js, return checks JSON
  - GET /api/memory → readFileSync .brain/MEMORY.md, return { content }
  - GET /api/debt → readFileSync .brain/DEBT.md, return { content }
- New POST endpoints:
  - POST /api/start → validate body { autoApprove?: boolean }, run runSprint() in background, return 202 { jobId, status: "started" }. If sprint already running return 409.
  - POST /api/plan → validate body { directive?: string }, call planSprint(), return plan JSON
  - POST /api/kill/:workerId → import killWindow from orchestra/tmux.js, kill worker tmux window, return { success }
  - POST /api/set-directives → validate body { content: string }, writeFileSync DIRECTIVES.md, return { success, taskCount } (parse ## Task blocks)
  - POST /api/config → validate body, merge with existing config, writeFileSync, return updated config
- Track active sprint: let activeJob: { id, status, result?, error? } | null
- GET /api/job/:jobId → return job status/result
- Add tests in tests/api/server.test.ts (extend existing, mock fs/http)
- Import constants: PROJECT_CONFIG_PATH, BRAIN_DIR, MEMORY_FILE, DEBT_FILE, DIRECTIVES_FILE from core/constants.js
- Dosya: src/api/server.ts, tests/api/server.test.ts
- Kapsam: src/api/, tests/api/
